text: The lamp controller shall report its supply voltage to the panel every 30 seconds.
The lamp controller shall switch the lamp off when the cover has been open for more than 20 seconds.
The panel shall show a warning within 2 seconds of a supply voltage below 11 volts.
The lamp controller shall keep the last brightness setting after a power cut of up to 60 minutes.
The cover sensor shall detect an open cover at any angle above 15 degrees.
The panel shall let an operator dim the lamp in steps of 5 percent from 10 to 100 percent.
The lamp controller shall refuse a brightness setting outside the range 10 to 100 percent.
The supply monitor shall measure voltage with an error of no more than 0.3 volts.
